topic: Inserting fake session data into device_session
summary_markdown: Someone confirmed the completion of a task and provided a SQL script for calibration. Later, [p1] inquired about inserting fake session data into the `device_session` table. It was decided that [p1] should upload the data as a `.pqt` file to the specified AllUnite S3 bucket.
decisions: Fake session data will be inserted into the device_session table using a .pqt file format.
action_items: [p1] must upload the .pqt file containing fake session data to the AllUnite S3 bucket.
